summary: Frontend-only testing of 'Confeti Meta' feature on GymTrack Pro Home. Seeded guest sessions in distinct weekdays of current week and verified confetti + toast celebration behavior across 5 scenarios. All scenarios passed with 100% success.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.js is ~410 lines and growing; consider splitting into subcomponents (GoalCard, StreakCard, ShareModal) for maintainability.
fireVoltConfetti recursion via requestAnimationFrame is not cancellable on unmount — negligible in this case (800ms) but could be tied to a mounted-ref if extended.

Celebration useEffect depends on daysThisWeek/weeklyGoal only; if weeklyGoal is manually set in localStorage to a lower value in another tab, celebration won't retrigger until re-render — acceptable but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Injected 3 sessions into localStorage 'gymtrack_guest_sessions' on Mon/Tue/Wed of the current week to satisfy the default weekly goal of 3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test 1 (fresh state, goal met): toast '¡Meta semanal cumplida!' shown, canvas element injected by canvas-confetti (1 canvas), and localStorage['gymtrack_goal_celebrated_week'] correctly set to current Monday timestamp (1789344000000). Test 2 (reload after celebration): no toast, key persists — one-shot per week works. Test 3 (goal 5 > days 3): no celebration, key remains null. Test 4 (decrease goal from 5 to 3): celebration fires exactly when daysThisWeek>=goal transitions to true, toast + canvas appear, key persisted. Test 5 (regression): home-goal-card, home-goal-progress, home-goal-value, home-goal-increase/decrease, and home-streak-share-btn all functional; no console errors (only expected React Router future-flag warnings).
